mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portal_demand_sequence (business_date, last_number) VALUES (#{date}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_number = last_number
mapper.update: UPDATE portal_demand_sequence SET last_number = last_number + 1 WHERE business_date = #{date} AND last_number < 9999
mapper.select: SELECT last_number FROM portal_demand_sequence WHERE business_date = #{date} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portal_demand (id, number, name, category, description, applicant_id, status, create_time, update_time, form_json) VALUES (#{request.id}, #{request.number}, #{request.name}, #{request.category}, #{request.description}, #{request.applicantId}, #{request.status}, #{request.createTime}, #{request.updateTime}, #{request.formJson})
mapper.sql: id, number, name, category, description, applicant_id AS applicantId, status, create_time AS createTime
, update_time AS updateTime, form_json AS formJson
mapper.select: SELECT FROM portal_demand WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE portal_demand SET status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portal_demand_log (demand_id, operation_time, operator_id, previous_status, action, opinion, next_status, next_operator_id, stage_seconds) VALUES (#{id}, #{log.operationTime}, #{log.operatorId}, #{log.previousStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.action}, #{log.opinion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.nextStatus}, #{log.nextOperatorId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{log.stageSeconds,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: SELECT operation_time AS operationTime, operator_id AS operatorId, previous_status AS previousStatus, action, opinion, next_status AS nextStatus, next_operator_id AS nextOperatorId, stage_seconds AS stageSeconds FROM portal_demand_log WHERE demand_id = #{id} ORDER BY operation_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT FROM portal_demand
ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
